method.timing: Separate untraced BenchBro runs. Two alternating before/after passes; graph/scope cases 9 repeats, 2 warmups; runtime cases 15 repeats, 5 warmups, 5000 iterations. No concurrent tests or timing workloads.
method.memory: BenchBro tracemalloc peak: 1 iteration per repeat, 9 repeats; graph GC inherited, scope GC disabled. Three alternating fresh-process four-route build samples use normal GC and sample retained bytes after GC with runtime alive. No RSS measured.
method.summary: Mean of the two final run medians for time and of the two run peak-allocation means for BenchBro memory. Median of three fresh-process heap samples.
method.exploratory: Initial before-1/after-1 pass used disabled GC for graph memory; included separately, excluded from final aggregate. Resource-scope +5.2% timing in that pass did not repeat.
method.source: Baseline is a git archive of the stated revision, executed with the same Python and dependencies; benchmark/evidence files copied identically into both trees. Source hashes, rather than inherited parent-git metadata, identify each source tree.
